name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with domain=chapter_event_handler. The 0x42 is the dispatch index in the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 (entry @ 0x51C99, offset 0x108 = index 0x42), a meaningful domain ID, NOT Ghidra address residue (own address is 0x359C8). 'ch28' = chapter 28, the chapter that fires this slot (turn-event slot 0, turn=0xFF sentinel), a meaningful domain ID. 'dialog_with_state' is the established category descriptor used consistently by sibling handlers (35/38/46). Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Chapter-28 turn-FF marker scene (dispatch idx 0x42): show dialog page 3, play one chapter-portrait white-flash cutscene at tile (0x11, 0x12), then show dialog page 6 -- the two dialog pages bracket the portrait reveal.
logic_summary: Straight-line three-call sequence with a __CHK(0x28) stack-check prologue. (1) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=3, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) -- inline dialog page 3 against the current chapter text at the 0xA0000 VGA target. (2) fd2_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash(0x11, 0x12, 1) -- portrait white-flash cutscene at tile (0x11, 0x12) with the third arg (1) forwarded as the portrait-group/race selector (named chapter_id at the call site). (3) fd2_display_dialog_scene(..., page=6, ...) -- inline dialog page 6. No use of the event_arg. The binary additionally HOSTS three Class-3 shared tails borrowed by other handlers via tail-JMP (alt_37 @ 0x359FF, alt_58 @ 0x35A20, alt_66 @ 0x35A2E -- the lone RET); those are pure code-sharing optimisations confirmed by xref and do not affect this handler's own straight-line source.
